{{Quote|Jib Kopatha.. I have need of you.|Darth Vader|<ref name="Empire-19" />}}
The '''mission to Void Station''' took place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was sent to extract information from an [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] called [[Jib Kopatha]], regarding the whereabouts of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], and to intimidate Kopatha.

Upon arrival, Vader interrupted Kopatha's greetings by [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Choke|Force choking]] the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]], which resulted in the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] being attacked by Jib's [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]], namely an [[Unidentified Gamorrean guard|Gamorrean]] and a [[Unidentified Nikto protector|Nikto]]. They were easily defeated by Vader, who then proceeded by telling Kopatha that the information he provided had become increasingly unreliable, that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] didn't accept incompetence and that the consequences, if the trend was to continue, would be very dire.

Kopatha desperately swore that it would not happen again. When Vader requested information about the rebels, he insisted on that they were very good at covering their tracks. Instead, he offered a multitude of [[Foodstuff/Legends|delicacies]], beverages and women. Vader refused and left Kopatha. On his way to his [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]], he was approached by a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] by the name of [[Xora]], who claimed that Jib knew more than he had told Vader.

She managed to lure him with her to an empty [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]], where she told Vader that she had no knowledge of the Rebels. Instead, she revealed that she were out to avenge the thousands of Falleen which Vader had killed when he ordered the ''sterilization'' of a major city on [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]]. Six of her comrades, among them [[Zuur]], came out of hiding, attacking the Sith.

It were a brief fight, as Vader easily managed to overcome the would-be assassins. In her last breath, Xora told him that he could never escape his past. Leaving the dead Falleen on the floor, Vader returned to his ship, were an [[Unidentified Imperial officer (Void Station)|officer]] who had accompanied him to the station noticed that his [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|suit]] had been damaged. When asked about it, Vader merely told him to prepare the ship for take-off.

==Behind the scenes==
Originally, [[Empire 19|''Star Wars: Empire 19'']] incorrectly placed five months after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] although the [[Evacuation of Yavin]] (mentioned in the story) took place six months after the Battle of Yavin according to most sources, including ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. The mistake has been corrected with the release of [[Star Wars Omnibus: At War with the Empire Volume 1|''Star Wars Omnibus: At War with the Empire Volume'' 1]].
